source: MMAH Supplementary Standard SB-1 (2024), Table 2 — Ss and Sr by location
part9_formula: S = Cb x Ss + Sr, Cb = 0.45 where the entire width of the roof does not exceed 4.3 m, otherwise 0.55; S not less than 1.0 kPa (Article 9.4.2.2)
part4_formula_simplified: S = Is [ Ss (Cb Cw Ce Ca) + Sr ], with Cb = 0.8 and Cw = Ce = Ca = 1.0 for a simple low roof away from drift sources (Article 4.1.6.2). Importance factor Is: Low 0.8, Normal 1.0, High 1.15, Post-disaster 1.25.
warning: Drifting against higher walls, parapets and rooftop units (Ca) and slippery or steep roofs change the Part 4 result. This tool is the uniform-load starting point only.
